description: Orientation and ground rules for the IntentumDiff / py-semantic-diff repository (a Rust+Python semantic-diff engine with a VS Code extension). Use this skill FIRST whenever you start any task in this repo — implementing a feature, fixing a bug, reviewing code, or answering "how does X work / where does X live". It maps the repo, states the Rust-vs-Python engine boundary, gives the exact build/test/run commands (including the maturin --release and .pyd-locking gotchas that silently waste hours), and lists the hard invariants you must not break. If a task touches the diff engine, the extension UX, release notes, or images, read this then hand off to the more specific intentumdiff-* skill. Trigger even when the user doesn't say "architecture" — any work in this repo benefits from it.
